summary: Updated the implementation plan to unify DnD35EffectBundleSchema across Feats, Class Features, Domain Granted Powers, Racial Traits, Creature Types, Subtypes, and Templates, explicitly supporting the 4-part anatomy of D&D 3.5e abilities: (1) Passive/Conditional Modifiers & Rule Overrides, (2) Structural Grants (including virtual feat grants that bypass prerequisites and respect runtime activation conditions like armor/load), (3) Activated/Toggled/SLA Abilities & Resource Pools, and (4) Nested Child Bundles with atomic suppression/trading via suppressedBundleIds.
